- Eliminated duplicate refunds during a partial outage by introducing idempotency keys backed by a unique constraint, taking the weekly duplicate count from 37 to zero
- Migrated 11 cron jobs to a Celery beat schedule with dead-letter retries, cutting silent job failures from roughly 9 per month to 1
- Built a Prometheus and Grafana dashboard tracking latency percentiles and queue depth, which caught a slow memory leak in the settlement worker before it reached production
